name: Does stucco re-coating improve energy efficiency?
description: Yes, some stucco re-coating products, especially lighter or reflective coatings, can improve energy efficiency by reducing heat absorption.

mainEntity.name: Does stucco re-coating improve energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some stucco re-coating products can offer a degree of improved energy efficiency. Lighter-colored elastomeric or acrylic coatings, particularly those with reflective properties, can help reduce heat absorption on exterior walls, especially in sunny climates like Pasadena. This can lead to a cooler interior during warmer months and potentially lower cooling costs. While not its primary purpose, selecting a re-coating material with insulating or reflective qualities can contribute to better thermal performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, some stucco re-coating products, especially lighter or reflective coatings, can improve energy efficiency by reducing heat absorption.
